Front Runners New York Sunday Bike Rides

New York, NY · Washington Heights · Road

LGBTQ+

Front Runners New York Sunday Bike Rides is a road group ride in New York, NY. Schedule: Sunday mornings, sometimes Saturday, spring through early fall, from George Washington Bridge (most rides), then north on Route 9W. About 20–40 miles, varies; rides for newer and stronger riders.

About the Front Runners New York Sunday Bike Rides group ride

Front Runners New York is an LGBTQ+ running and multisport club. Its multisport group leads outdoor bike rides on Sunday mornings in the warm months. Most go over the George Washington Bridge and up 9W, with the odd longer day to Bear Mountain or a beach ride in summer. Details go out in the club's weekly multisport email.
